browser_navigate.title: Navigate Browser
browser_navigate.description: Navigate the PLA-managed browser session to a URL.

browser_snapshot.title: Inspect Browser
browser_snapshot.description: Return a semantic accessibility snapshot of the current page. Prefer this over screenshots for interaction decisions.

browser_find.title: Find In Browser
browser_find.description: Search the current accessibility snapshot for text or a regular expression and return compact matching context.

browser_click.title: Click Browser Element
browser_click.description: Click one semantic element reference from a browser inspection. Browser downloads are imported into the PLA Artifact Plane instead of exposing filesystem paths.

browser_type.title: Type Into Browser Element
browser_type.description: Type text into one semantic element reference from a browser inspection.

browser_file_upload.title: Upload Browser Artifacts
browser_file_upload.description: Handle an active browser file chooser using PLA Artifact references. The paths array contains Artifact IDs, never caller-supplied filesystem paths.

browser_fill_form.title: Fill Browser Form
browser_fill_form.description: Fill multiple semantic form fields in one deterministic browser action.

browser_press_key.title: Press Browser Key
browser_press_key.description: Press a keyboard key in the current browser page.

browser_wait_for.title: Wait For Browser State
browser_wait_for.description: Wait for text, disappearance, or a bounded delay in the current page.

browser_tabs.title: Manage Browser Tabs
browser_tabs.description: List, create, select, or close tabs in the PLA-managed browser session.

browser_take_screenshot.title: Capture Browser Screenshot
browser_take_screenshot.description: Capture a PNG visual screenshot for layout and rendering verification. PLA manages the output path and returns an Artifact; semantic interaction should still prefer browser.inspect.

browser_console_messages.title: Read Browser Console
browser_console_messages.description: Read bounded browser console messages for debugging and verification.

browser_network_requests.title: Read Browser Network Requests
browser_network_requests.description: Read bounded network request metadata observed in the current browser page.

browser_close.title: Close Browser Session
browser_close.description: Close the current PLA-managed browser page/session while preserving the managed profile on disk.
